description: This file defines a custom exception class PasswordTooWeakException used in the account exception package of the book project. It extends RuntimeException and is annotated to exclude it from Jacoco code coverage reports.

classes.name: PasswordTooWeakException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception thrown when a user's password is deemed too weak.
